caption_final:
Blade Runner 2099, a new eight-episode limited series, drops all at once on Prime Video on 25 November, in India and worldwide. Prime Video released its final trailer on 9 November.

The story is set 50 years after Blade Runner 2049 (2017), in a Los Angeles that Prime Video describes as "reborn, just not by humanity". Hunter Schafer plays Cora, a fugitive who takes on "one last identity: a Blade Runner". She is forced to partner with Olwen (Michelle Yeoh), a Replicant days from dying.

Silka Luisa is the showrunner. Ridley Scott, who directed the 1982 original, is an executive producer.

What was the last series you finished in the same week it dropped?
